summary: SBIN Depth across a dropped socket: both feeds are sent again on the new connection, and its first quote is not paired with the book from before the outage; the new session's book is.

deviations.reason: The web's Tradejini adapter puts its subscription mode number (1, 2, 3) in data.mode; the desktop sends the label (ltp, quote, full). Phase B: follows the web adapter through wire's per-broker switch in the dialect table (Tradejini: the number).

Tradejini sends the trade time in epoch seconds; the web formats it with the server's local time zone into a text such as "2025-11-05 14:25:31" (nxtradstream.py datefmt) and sends that as ltt, where feed timestamps are epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md). The desktop sends epoch ms, and leaves ltt out when Tradejini sent no trade time, where the web sends null (Quote, Depth) or "" (LTP).
The web sends Tradejini's upper circuit limit (L1 ucl) on Depth; the desktop decodes it (streaming.rs L1::ucl) but the common carrier drops it.
deviations.ref: tradejini_adapter.py:852; audit appendix 'fields dropped by the common carrier' (lane wire)

deviations.reason: As upper_circuit, for the lower limit (L1 lcl).
deviations.ref: tradejini_adapter.py:853; audit appendix 'fields dropped by the common carrier' (lane wire)

deviations.reason: The web sends Tradejini's own change (chng) in Quote and Depth for every instrument; the desktop sends the change for indices only.
As change: the web's second name for chngPer (web openalgo#2383).

The web also sends the trade time as last_trade_time (the same local-time text as its ltt, a web defect); the desktop sends no last_trade_time for Tradejini. Phase B: the dialect alias in epoch ms beside ltt, as Samco, 5paisa and mStock have it (feed::dialect, lane wire); the value then stays a declared web defect.

The web's Tradejini adapter sends OI as oi only; the desktop sends open_interest beside it. Phase B: follows the web adapter through wire's per-broker switch in the dialect table (Tradejini: no open_interest).
